environment.description: Flask application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) behind an Application Load Balancer with default settings. No WAF attached. ALB forwards all traffic directly to the application on port 8080. The instance runs Amazon Linux 2 with the app managed by systemd. UPLOAD_FOLDER is /var/app/uploads. The filesystem has standard Linux permissions with the app running as 'webapp' user which has read access to /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow (misconfigured), and other system files.

config.filesystem_permissions: webapp user has broad read access
